faqs.question: How much does bat removal cost in Floral Park?
faqs.answer: The cost of bat removal in Floral Park depends on the size of your property, the severity of the infestation, and the treatment method required. Contact us at (855) 930-5016 for a free phone consultation with no hidden fees.

faqs.question: Is bat removal legal in New York?
faqs.answer: Yes, but bat removal in New York must follow strict guidelines. We use humane exclusion methods that allow bats to leave but not re-enter. Removal during maternity season (May 1 - August 15) is restricted to protect flightless young bats, so timing is crucial for legal compliance.

faqs.question: How do I know if I have bats in my Floral Park attic?
faqs.answer: Common signs include squeaking or scratching noises at dusk and dawn, bat droppings (guano) in attics or near entry points, dark staining around potential entry holes, and seeing bats exit your home at sunset. During your free phone consultation, we'll discuss bat presence indicators and identify potential entry points.

faqs.question: Will bats return after exclusion?
faqs.answer: When properly executed, our exclusion methods prevent bats from returning permanently. We seal all entry points (as small as 3/8 inch) using durable materials, install one-way exit devices. Most Floral Park customers experience complete resolution after our service.
